description_en: Queries the SMS sending records and sending status of a single phone number
description_zh: 查询单个号码的短信发送记录和发送状态等信息
name: QuerySendDetails

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried. Format:

Domestic SMS: an 11-digit phone number, such as 1390000\\.
International or Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan SMS: country code + phone number, such as 8520000\\.

You can specify only one phone number
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的手机号码。格式：

国内短信：11位手机号码，例如1390000\\。
国际/港澳台消息：国际区号+号码，例如8520000\\。

只能传入一个手机号码
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the sending receipt, which is the sending serial number. This is the BizId field in the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419274.html operation to send an SMS message.

You can specify only one BizId value
parameters.help_zh:
发送回执ID。即发送流水号，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419274.html发送短信时，返回值中的BizId字段。

只能传入一个Bizid的值，无法传入多个Bizid
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The date when the SMS message was sent. You can query records from the last 30 days.

Format: yyyyMMdd, such as 20250601
parameters.help_zh:
短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式：yyyyMMdd，例如20250601
parameters.name: send_date

parameters.help_en:
The number of SMS records to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的短信记录数量，供分页查看发送记录使用。

取值范围为1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number of the sending records
parameters.help_zh: 发送记录的当前页码，供分页查看发送记录使用
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

A value of OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Content.description_en: The content of the SMS message
Content.example: 【阿里云】验证码为：123，您正在登录，若非本人操作，请勿泄露

ErrCode.description_en:
The SMS status code returned by the carrier.

If the SMS message was sent successfully, the value is DELIVERED.
If the SMS message failed to be sent, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101347.html） for the error code
ErrCode.description_zh:
运营商短信状态码。

短信发送成功：DELIVERED。
短信发送失败：失败错误码请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101347.html）

OutId.description_en:
The extended field for the external serial number.

If the OutId parameter is not specified when the SMS message is sent, this operation does not return the OutId field
OutId.description_zh:
外部流水扩展字段。

若发送短信时未传入OutId，本接口将不会返回OutId字段

PhoneNum.description_en: The phone number that received the SMS message

ReceiveDate.description_en: The date and time when the SMS message was received

SendDate.description_en: The date and time when the SMS message was sent

SendStatus.description_en:
The sending status of the SMS message. Valid values:

1: Waiting for receipt.
2: Sending failed.
3: Sending succeeded
SendStatus.description_zh:
短信发送状态，包括：

1：等待回执。
2：发送失败。
3：发送成功

ServiceItemStatus.description_en: The status of the SMS service item

SkuCode.description_en: The specification code of the SMS service

TemplateCode.description_en:
The code of the SMS template.

If you use the `[Test Only] Alibaba Cloud Communications` signature and the `[Test Only] Alibaba Cloud Communications Test Template` template to send test SMS messages, this operation does not return the TemplateCode field
TemplateCode.description_zh:
短信模板Code。

若选择`[测试专用]阿里云通信`和`[测试专用]阿里云通信测试模板`发送的测试短信，本接口将不会返回TemplateCode字段

TotalCount.description_en:
The total number of SMS messages sent.


This value indicates the number of submissions, not the number of billable messages
TotalCount.description_zh:
短信发送总条数。


提交维度的发送次数，非计费维度
